reason: Evidence from the repository README and package manifest shows this plugin is a DeepSeek Harness settings UI for managing web profile plugins via a two-column enabled/disabled board with drag-based enable/disable and load-order editing, plus metadata/diagnostic viewing and a save-draft then apply workflow.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的插件管理界面插件，提供两栏拖拽操作来启用、禁用并调整插件加载顺序，并可查看插件与加载项详情后保存草稿再应用。
summaries.en: This plugin provides a DeepSeek Harness settings UI to enable or disable plugins and reorder their load order via a two-column drag interface, with details views and a draft-then-apply workflow.

capabilities: Provides a web settings-panel interface to move plugins between enabled and disabled states
Allows drag-based reordering of enabled plugins to change load order
Supports draft-save then apply flow for plugin profile changes
Displays plugin and loader entry details such as id/name/version/repository and diagnostics
